title: Director, Art Direction - Unpublished R&D Product
description:
Art Directors at Riot drive the quality and performance of their team, establishing direction and goals that provide clarity and focus. Your scope of responsibilities include leading with vision, strategic partnership across the game, a deep understanding of audience resonance, overall team culture and performance, growth of your direct reports, and directing your team on successful execution of your vision and strategy.

As an Art Director an unpublished R&D product, you will help bring the game’s visual direction to life in a new game for players around the world. You will translate our creative direction into a distinctive, emotionally compelling, production-ready visual identity that supports gameplay, strengthens character appeal, and meets the craft bar players expect from Riot. You will partner closely with Creative Direction, Game Leadership, cross-disciplinary teams, and external partners to translate the game’s visual ambition into a cohesive, art direction. 

Responsibilities:

  • Steward the game’s visual identity from concept through production
  • Translate creative direction into clear visual standards, production practices, and scalable art workflows
  • Drive visual quality, appeal, and gameplay readability across all player-facing art
  • Apply deep expertise in the art style across art, animation, VFX, visual storytelling, and character-driven experiences
  • Balance artistic ambition with technical requirements and production realities
  • Build, lead, and mentor high-performing internal and external art teams
  • Direct co-development partners, vendors, and distributed creative talent to deliver consistently high-quality work
  • Partner across design, narrative, audio, engineering, product, and IP to ensure art strengthens the player experience
  • Provide clear visual feedback through reviews, paintovers, references, and development guidance
  • Maintain deep awareness of the art style, creative influences, and evolving player expectations

Required Qualifications: 

  • 12+ years of experience developing games, with 8+ years leading art teams
  • Experience as an Art Director or key artistic decision maker on at least one shipped 3D game
  • Experience delivering games with strong character appeal in both model and animation
  • Strong understanding of the pipelines, production techniques, and technical constraints required to deliver stylized visuals in games
  • Strong artistic judgment across character design, composition, shape language, color, lighting, animation, VFX, and gameplay readability
  • Experience balancing visual quality against technical, production, platform, and team-size constraints
  • Experience building, leading, mentoring, and aligning art teams across cross-functional game development
  • Experience directing external vendors or distributed art teams
  • Champion of healthy creative processes that support iteration, alignment, scalable production, and strong artistic quality
  • Experience leveraging emerging technologies and workflows, to accelerate visual development while maintaining artistic quality, authorship, and creative integrity
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong artistic judgment, visual clarity, compositional skill, and stylistic range
  • Experience developing games in modern game engines (i.e. Unreal, Unity, etc)

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience developing art direction for live-service, multiplayer, or other technically constrained games
  • Experience with 3D games that place high demands on character appeal, animation, VFX, camera, gameplay readability, or combat clarity
  • Working knowledge of stylized rendering techniques, VFX, animation, and visual clarity for gameplay

title: Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about its craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s Windows client services. You’ll set technical direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s Anti-Cheat suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in cheat communities and techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed. You’ll help the team anticipate and analyze emerging cheat techniques, then translate those findings into effective detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. 

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, identify, recruit, interview, and hire engineers to help the team scale effectively
  • Set direction and drive high-impact anti-cheat capabilities from ambiguity through production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Lead the team in rapidly translating emerging threats into resilient detections and preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed at scale
  • Balance immediate threat response with proactive technical investments that anticipate adversaries’ next moves or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Guide and participate in complex investigations involving highly evasive cheats and operating-system manipulation techniques
  • Ensure the team can diagnose and resolve complex compatibility, reliability, and security issues in highly opaque environments, stepping into the details when needed
  • Build trusted relationships with game teams as internal customers, helping them understand their cheating ecosystems, integrate Anti-Cheat effectively, and make informed tradeoffs across security, player experience, scope, and delivery
  • Establish clear priorities and technical expectations, helping engineers navigate uncertainty and make sound decisions across security, compatibility, performance, and operational risk
  • Partner across engineering, product, operations, and game teams to align dependencies, communicate risk, and deliver anti-cheat capabilities successfully across Riot’s portfolio

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience leading product or developing engineers, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Technical Product Lead
  • Familiarity with cheat-development or game-security research communities and a practical understanding of modern cheat techniques and anti-cheat evasions
  • Strong understanding of Anti-Cheat architectures, with the ability to evaluate designs, guide technical discussions, and engage directly when complex problems require it
  • Experience leading work on low-level, security-sensitive systems and helping teams navigate tradeoffs across security, reliability, compatibility, performance, and delivery
  • Working knowledge of Windows security model and security feature suite such as Secure Boot, HVCI, and measured boot attestation

Desired Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with reverse-engineering techniques and workflows, including the analysis of packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries, with the judgment to translate technical findings into priorities, investments, and defensive strategy
  • Working knowledge of the Windows kernel and driver model, sufficient enough to guide architecture, assess technical risk, and oversee the development and operation of production-grade kernel-mode drivers
  • Working knowledge of advanced evasion techniques involving hypervisors, DKOM, EPT manipulation, vulnerable drivers, or hardware-assisted cheats, with the ability to reason about their implications for product and technical strategy
  • Basic understanding of runtime integrity verification, behavioral detection, client attestation, and other signature-less anti-cheat techniques, including how to prioritize investments across these defensive approaches
  • Experience balancing near-term responses to emerging threats with longer-term, proactive investments intended to anticipate how adversaries and the broader security landscape will evolve
  • Experience partnering with internal customers, building trusted relationships, translating their needs into technical priorities, and leading productive conversations around scope, risk, sequencing, and delivery tradeoffs

title: Principal Creative Director, Growth Marketing & Lifecycle
description:
As the Principal Marketing Creative Director, Growth Marketing and Lifecycle, you will define the creative vision for Riot’s global Growth Marketing efforts, helping players discover and return to our games. Reporting to the Director of Creative, Marketing Creative Services, you will serve as Riot’s resident expert in growth marketing creative, combining deep knowledge of the performance marketing landscape with world-class creative leadership.

Embedded with Riot’s Growth Marketing team, you will partner closely with Growth leads across Riot’s portfolio to translate each game’s strategic objectives into high-performing creative, applying proven performance practices while ensuring the work authentically reflects the game and its community.

You will own Growth Creative direction across Riot’s global portfolio, including approaches that enable effective localized creative at scale. You’ll partner with each game’s Marketing Creative Director at key milestones to align with broader brand positioning and identity, while establishing the guardrails and making the creative decisions needed for the Growth pipeline to operate quickly and autonomously.

Working with Growth strategy partners, you’ll build an iterative, data-informed creative practice - using performance signals to guide decisions while applying creative judgment to understand when to follow, challenge, or move beyond the data.

You will lead Riot’s external ecosystem of agencies, creators, and production partners - selecting the right partners, setting creative standards, and ensuring they deliver authentic, effective work at the speed and scale Growth Marketing requires.

This role requires exceptional creative judgment, deep fluency in modern UA creative, and the ability to operate independently within a complex global organization. You’ll know when to seek alignment, when to drive a decision, and when to make the creative call that keeps the work moving.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the creative vision, quality bar, and operating model for Growth Marketing creative across Riot’s portfolio.

title: Revenue Accounting Manager
description:
As a Revenue Accounting Manager, you’ll be in charge of certain areas of the game revenue accounting at Riot Games.  This involves critical accounting player life estimates, big data transaction reconciliation and automation for micropayments, devising structure to address controls and risks including for accounts receivable, and thoughtfully developing the technical accounting for emerging revenue issues.  To be successful, you’ll need to be flexible working at both a review level and a hands-on detailed level.  You will drive projects forward and collaborate with other teams including Finance, Game teams, Payments, Legal, Data, and accounting teams in our global offices.

This position reports to the Accounting Director and will play a key leadership role in the overall Accounting organization around change management, improving processes and controls, scaling accounting, company infrastructure and operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Deeply understand Riot’s statistical player life estimate calculation and work with a data analyst to maintain it.  This includes doing analysis to explain changes, working on audit deliverables, and understanding how this estimate would apply to new products.
  • Reconcile large sales datasets with engineering team across the order to cash process.  This data would include information from international payment processors with unique fees, FX, and taxes.
  • Further develop processes and automation with the engineering team to increase efficiency and scope of the large data reconciliation noted above.  This includes project management, understanding system data flows, and cross team collaboration.
  • Research and formalize technical accounting including Principal vs Agent, Point in Time vs Over Time, Costs to obtain a contract, and Consideration payable to a customer.  
  • Review draft contracts to ensure smooth technical accounting.
  • Build out approaches and systems to address key risks such as receivables collectability and chargebacks monitoring.
  • Project manage and oversee certain day to day, period end close, and audit related activities

title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly
  • Experience building and debugging low-level, security-sensitive systems
  • Strong understanding of Windows process internals, including process and thread lifecycles, virtual memory, handles and objects, security contexts, executable image formats, DLL loading, and the Windows loader
  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience within cheat-development or game-security research communities, with practical knowledge of modern cheat techniques and anti-cheat evasions 
  • Familiarity with advanced evasion techniques involving hypervisors, DKOM, EPT manipulation, vulnerable drivers, or hardware-assisted cheats
  • Knowledge of runtime integrity verification, behavioral detection, client attestation, and other signature-less anti-cheat techniques

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Engineering & Process Excellence
description:

The portfolio includes custom applications, the company directory and organizational data APIs, and integrations with business systems.

You will manage a multidisciplinary team of software engineers and business systems analysts. This is not a traditional enterprise systems role. We are building a function that reimagines enterprise engineering and process excellence for an AI-enabled organization. We use process mining and telemetry to continuously improve how work gets done, integration and automation with AI to reduce manual effort, and purpose-built applications to create capabilities that differentiate Riot. You will connect what the business needs, how processes should work, and how technology can deliver improvements.

You will partner closely with leaders across People Tech, Finance Tech, and Enterprise Data & AI, as well as business stakeholders in Enterprise functions.

The role reports to the Director, Enterprise Systems.

Software Engineering

  • Set the strategy and technical direction for enterprise software engineering, integration, and automation.
  • Lead the design, development, and operation of reliable applications, APIs, integrations, and automations that support critical enterprise capabilities.
  • Establish strong engineering practices across architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, reliability, and production support.
  • Develop the Integration & Automation Center of Excellence through reusable patterns, shared platforms, governance, and enablement across Enterprise Systems.

Business Process Excellence

  • Build and lead a modern process excellence practice that uses process mining, telemetry, and AI-enabled tools to identify, prioritize, and measure improvement opportunities.
  • Lead the redesign of complex, cross-functional enterprise processes, translating business needs into clear requirements and scalable solutions.
  • Establish practical standards for process ownership, governance, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with business and technology leaders to deliver measurable improvements in cycle time, quality, automation, and Rioter experience.

People Leadership, Delivery & Partner Management

  • 8+ years of experience managing software engineers, business systems analysts, or multidisciplinary technical teams.

description:

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in League of Legends, you will build applied machine learning systems that directly improve player experience. You will work across player and product problems through data, modeling, experimentation, launch, and iteration, partnering closely with League product, design, Insights, game engineering, and service engineering teams. title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise AI
description:
Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential by building secure, reliable, and scalable internal systems that keep the company running smoothly. 

As a Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in AI, you will personally design and build the AI agent capabilities and product experiences for an internal enterprise intelligence platform. This includes the retrieval, orchestration, and reasoning layer that sits on top of a semantic data layer built and maintained by a partner data engineering team. You’ll turn these capabilities into search, chat, and workflow experiences that help leaders find information and make decisions faster. This is a hands-on, coding-majority role. You’ll build the agents, prompts, tool integrations, and full-stack product surface yourself. 

You’ll work directly with product owners, system leads, and domain experts across HR, Finance, IT, Legal, and Workplace to understand real workflows. You’ll also work closely with a partner data engineering team that owns ingestion, the semantic layer, and the underlying data model. You will consume and help shape requirements for that layer rather than building it yourself. Your work will directly improve how Rioters hire, plan, spend, onboard, and operate at scale. 

The ideal candidate is a deeply experienced full-stack software engineer who has personally shipped AI-enabled products at scale, is comfortable building in ambiguous and evolving problem spaces, and takes ownership of systems from the first commit through production operation. 

The role will report to the Manager of Enterprise Systems Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain an orchestrator + specialist-agent architecture (retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, multi-step reasoning) on top of a semantic data layer owned by a partner data team. 
  • Design and implement retrieval and grounding for RAG/semantic search use cases: embeddings, reranking, citation of evidence, and techniques to reduce hallucination.
  • Integrate agents with internal and external tools/APIs (function/tool calling) to let them take real actions, not just answer questions. 
  • Build the full-stack application layer, APIs, and UI that exposes AI-powered search, chat, and workflow experiences to end users. 
  • Instrument AI features with observability for quality, latency, token usage, and cost, and use it to drive iteration and tuning. 
  • Iterate on prompts and model choices quickly, with sensible fallback behavior when a model, tool, or retrieval step fails or returns low-confidence output. 
  • Apply solid engineering fundamentals: source control, code review, automated testing (unit, integration, functional), CI/CD, and on-call for the systems you own.

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent professional experience delivering enterprise technology solutions). 
  • 8+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development 
  • Practical, end-to-end experience building RAG or agentic systems: retrieval, tool-calling, structured outputs, multi-step reasoning, and verification/evaluation loops, not just familiarity with LLM APIs. 
  • Experience designing and running evaluation approaches for nondeterministic systems: curated datasets, automated metrics, human review, and production feedback.
  • Experience establishing basic AI observability (quality, safety, reliability, latency, token usage, cost) for features you build. 
  • Working understanding of AI security and responsible-use risks, prompt injection, tool abuse, data leakage, access control, model limitations, sufficient to build safeguards into what you ship. 
  • Deep hands-on programming experience in Node, TypeScript, React. 
  • Experience with modern frameworks (e.g., NextJS, NestJS). 
  • Experience building RESTful and GraphQL APIs, working with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non-relational (e.g., Redis) databases. 
  • Comfortable with cloud infrastructure and deployment: AWS, containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Familiar with software engineering best practices: automated testing, code review, monitoring/observability, security and performance considerations.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Deep practical knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation and semantic search, including embedding and reranking models, retrieval design, grounding, citations, and evaluation. 
  • Experience with agent platforms (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or comparable), vector databases, and multi-agent orchestration patterns. 
  • Working familiarity with Python and lakehouse/data-catalog concepts (e.g., Databricks, Unity Catalog), enough to collaborate effectively with the data engineering team, without needing to own pipeline build-out. 
  • Experience shipping an internal AI product from scratch as part of a small, fast-moving team, comfortable with a "scrappy MVP, iterate" delivery style rather than a fully-specified roadmap.

title: Senior VFX Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
description:
As part of the Real-Time VFX team, you’ll design and help implement the sleek, dynamic and dramatic special effects that add atmosphere and depth to gameplay. With your experience, you’ll create aesthetically astounding visual effects that communicate essential game information. You’ll use your artistic and technical skills to breathe life into undead spells, channel primal emotions and capture the essence of hundreds of champions.

As a Senior VFX Artist on the Riot Discovery Studio (RDS) team, you will report to the Sr. VFX Manager and play a key role on a small VFX team delivering high-spectacle gameplay experiences. Under the direction of the VFX Lead, you will use your creative and technical expertise to design, execute, and implement a wide range of gameplay and environmental visual effects. You’ll partner closely with VFX, Design, and other disciplines to establish best practices, champion visual quality and gameplay clarity, and translate your expertise into scalable solutions as the team transitions into production. Beyond asset creation, you will help strengthen the VFX discipline by sharing craft expertise, leading discipline initiatives, and serving as a bridge between VFX and cross-functional partners. You will also support team leadership with operational and discipline-development efforts that help the team work effectively and sustainably. RDS operates in a highly iterative environment, so you’ll need to navigate ambiguity and respond thoughtfully to frequent shifts in content, creative direction, and priorities. As the team continues to define its VFX direction and production practices, your work and expertise will directly influence the quality bar and help establish what great VFX looks like for the product.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and deliver polished, dynamic visual effects that enhance atmosphere, depth, and gameplay while aligning with the project’s creative and stylistic goals.
  • Balance visual impact with gameplay clarity, ensuring effects accurately communicate actions, states, and player-facing information.
  • Autonomously create high-quality VFX by applying a broad range of craft skills, including painting, drawing, animation, and modeling as needed.
  • Establish and apply VFX best practices and scalable solutions, such as VFX theme kits, that support a broad range of production and product goals.
  • Represent the VFX discipline across cross-functional teams, providing subject matter expertise and advocating for the needs, capabilities, and opportunities of visual effects to have maximum player impact.
  • Uphold VFX craft quality standards through mentorship, constructive feedback, documentation, and accountability within the discipline.
  • Collaborate closely and proactively with VFX teammates, balancing complementary expertise and contributing to the ongoing development of the team and discipline.
  • When possible, contribute to the broader Riot VFX community by shaping initiatives, sharing expertise, and advancing discipline-wide goals.
  • Support healthy and effective team operations by participating in team rituals, meeting commitments and deadlines, identifying opportunities for improvement, and assisting product leadership with operational needs when necessary.
  • Take ownership of professional growth by maintaining and regularly engaging with a development plan in partnership with your manager.

Required Skills:

  • BA in Game Art Development (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of games industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist
  • 5+ years of professional experience and use of Unreal, Unity, or any relevant game engine
  • Proficiency with relevant DCC tools such as Maya, Photoshop, or Substance Designer, and implementation of this work into a game engine. 
  • Professional experience working on immersive, fast-paced, VFX that informs visual choices while maintaining clean, crisp gameplay readability
  • Experience mentoring and supporting other artists, providing thoughtful feedback and guidance, and collaborating effectively across disciplines. 

Desired Skills:

  • Developing VFX for various platforms (i.e. PC, console, etc.) 
  • Proficiency using Adobe Animate, AfterEffects, Houdini, FumeFX, Embergen, and Substance Painter

As a part of the application process, candidates will be expected to provide a portfolio or demo reel of their work and may be asked to complete an art test.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise and a collaborative spirit that prioritizes the delight of players. We will look at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this is the role for you!
